title: Maira’s Dream · Second Chances — the next visit
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Dense thrift-store dream with 1,152 individually pickable/inspectable merchandise items, real CC0 Poly Haven shelving and fluorescent lighting, animated Quaternius people, recorded Kenney footsteps and material Foley, and synthesized NPC murmurs. Quick E pickup, Q rotatable 3D inspection, basket/returns, staffed checkout and receipts. Escalating visits: smaller budgets, faster/more cats, randomized unexplained fire equipment; visit 3 requires tag switching or theft. Directional manager perception and A* pursuit. Desktop/touch controls, pause, retry and next visit. Prototype; no save, checkout queues or office escort yet.
